newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Trust to buy back eurodlr convertibles.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Trust to buy back eurodlr convertibles.

text.p: Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp said on Friday that it plans to buy back two series of eurodollar-denominated convertible bonds in cash.

The Japanese trust bank said in a statement that on June 30 it would start buying back its 1.75 percent convertible bonds maturing on September 30, 2002 and its 3.25 percent convertibles due on September 30, 2003.
The offer expires on July 28, it said.
The buyback plan is aimed at trimming its outstanding debt and strengthening its financial base, while trying to avoid a potential increase in the number of its shares, it said.

As of May 31, there was $31.06 million worth of the 1.75 percent convertible bonds outstanding and $66.52 million worth of the 3.25 percent bonds it said. The conversion prices of the bonds are 3,617.20 yen and 2,950.50 yen respectively, it said.
